steps.summary: Created the task from the 'Bench Board' board view via the Backlog column's "Add a new task" form, filled Title 'fwkb30-n2 Bench Task' and Description 'Task created for run fwkb30-n2', and clicked Save. The app assigned task ID 4 (task page heading "Task #4"), and the task landed in the default first column, Backlog. The task detail page (/?controller=TaskViewController&action=show&task_id=4) shows the title exactly as 'fwkb30-n2 Bench Task' and Description 'Task created for run fwkb30-n2', with Column: Backlog, Status: open.

On the Bench Board board view I dragged the card 'fwkb30-n2 Bench Task' (data-task-id=4) from the Backlog column onto the 'Work in progress' column, then reloaded the board to confirm persistence: the column header now reads "Work in progress" with a task count of 1 and task #4 is rendered under it, while Backlog shows only the three untouched 'Seed:' tasks (count 3). No 'Seed:' task was moved.
